title: Snow Globe viewpoint manifest
description: One file per viewpoint at viewpoints/manifests/<id>.json (PRD §8.2, Appendix A). Validated in CI by snow_globe_common.manifest, which also checks rules a schema cannot express: file name = id, place_id = prefix of id, IANA zone loads, one default per place, no alias shared across places (after normalising spaces, hyphens and apostrophes), landmark distance_km and azimuth_deg match the camera position, archive_since null exactly when archive_code is null. Fields marked M2 are optional until the plate build. Departures from the Appendix A sketch: pose fields sit in the top-level 'pose' object (not under camera), landmarks sit in the top-level 'landmarks' array (not under plate), and the hourly cap is polite_caps.max_images_per_hour (not max_per_hour).

place_id.description: The place this viewpoint belongs to; the part of id before the dot.

aliases.description: Lower-case names, nicknames and likely speech-to-text mishearings the parser matches (PRD §7.5). Words of letters, digits and apostrophes, joined by single spaces or hyphens.

default.description: True if this is the place's default viewpoint.

time_zone.description: IANA zone of the place; all times resolve here (PRD §7.4).

status.description: Build order (PRD §8.2): msv = MSV claims; third = built after the MSV; v1-candidate = captured, built later.

landmarks.description: Surveyed points in view. px stays null until the M2 pose solve.

attribution.description: Credit line shown with any frame or derivative (PRD §15.4).

pose.description: M2: camera pose solved from landmarks (PRD §8.5 steps 3, 7, 8).

plate.description: M2: plate set files and licences (PRD §8.5, Appendix A). The known keys are typed; others stay allowed until the M2 plate build fixes the set (TODO(M2): then set additionalProperties false). Landmarks do not go here: they live in the top-level 'landmarks' array, which is what forecast and eval read.

forecast_samples.description: M2: where view rays meet each cloud layer, with grid cells (PRD §8.3).

truth_sources.description: M2: independent truth votes, e.g. webcam, goes18_acmc (PRD §8.1).

camera.description: Camera site. Coordinates are WGS84; elevation is metres above mean sea level (NAVD88 where from USGS). position_uncertainty_m is an honest radius for the mount position.

view_azimuth_deg.description: Nominal view direction, degrees clockwise from true north (feed viewdetail or computed). The solved heading is pose.heading_deg (M2).

polite_caps.description: Collection limits (PRD §15.3): fetch only on change, at most 4 images per rolling hour, poll no faster than every 5 minutes.

truth_camera.description: The feed that supplies truth frames, with its licence facts (PRD §15.1 Cameras).

json_url.description: NPS ARD JSON feed, or null when the camera has none (poll HTTP headers instead).

archive_code.description: NPS /airwebcams archive location code (lower case), or null if there is no archive.

archive_since.description: First archive day (GetAvailableDays MinDay), or null; null exactly when archive_code is null (checked by the loader).

interval_min_nominal.description: Documented update interval in minutes, or null if undocumented (measure it).

interval_min_measured.description: Measured median update interval in minutes, filled by capture.

night_mode.description: What night frames look like: colour, infrared (monochrome), mixed, or unknown until checked (PRD §8.6 colour-mode gate).

publish_cleared.description: True only after written confirmation (PRD §15.1 Publication).

view_label.description: The operator's own caption, e.g. the feed's imagesite and viewdetail.

image_px.description: Measured width and height of one full-size frame.

height_m.description: Elevation of the landmark above mean sea level, metres.

azimuth_deg.description: Initial bearing from the camera, degrees from true north.

band.description: Which landmark band it belongs to (PRD §8.5 masks); summit is the P1 target at Rainier, whose plate bands are summit, upper, mid and near (PRD §13.3; plates/specs/rainier.paradise-mountain.v0.1.json).

px.description: Pixel position [x, y] in the full-size frame; null until M2.
